description: An H-gantry with a FEM crossbeam (ModalBody3D with a rail): two linear-motor X axes with servo drives, a Y carriage on the moving rail interface, point-to-point moves plain and input-shaped, racking, and the beam's stress, against a scipy modal model; plus the beam's static deflection and stress against beam theory.

the rail under the carriage moves by the beam's deflection (x, up in this view): beam theory, clamped-clamped over the elastic span 1.24 m with shear: the carriage P = 117.72 N at mid-span and the beam's weight w = 46.83 N/m, EI = 6.379e+04 N*m^2: 26.50 um
front wall 100 mm from A: M = -15.692 N*m at 100 mm from the clamp, sigma = M c / I = 387.3 kPa, torsion shear 57.8 kPa, von Mises 400.1 kPa
back wall 100 mm from A: M = -15.692 N*m at 100 mm from the clamp, sigma = M c / I = 631.1 kPa, torsion shear 144.6 kPa, von Mises 679.0 kPa

back wall mid-span, under the carriage: below the beam-theory 890.4 kPa (the guide blocks spread the load over 100 mm and the box's walls carry it with shear lag); the self-weight case checks this hotspot against beam theory
the beam's own weight alone (the Y carriage weightless), w = 46.83 N/m: w L^4 / (384 E I) + w L^2 / (8 k G A) = 5.24 um
front wall 100 mm from A: M = -3.331 N*m, sigma = M c / I = 82.2 kPa
back wall 100 mm from A: M = -3.331 N*m, sigma = M c / I = 134.0 kPa
